secrets.name: BINANCE_WEB3_API_KEY
secrets.description: Binance Web3 API key from the Developer Portal (https://web3.binance.com/en/dev-portal/project). Used as the X-OC-APIKEY header for authenticated API requests.

secrets.name: BINANCE_WEB3_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Binance Web3 API secret key from the Developer Portal. Used for HMAC-SHA256 request signing (X-OC-SIGN header). Never exposed to the browser.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key for natural-language strategy parsing. Optional — the app falls back to deterministic regex parsing when not set.
